index.title: Regulatory Compliance Checker
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Regulatory Compliance Navigator. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Regulatory Compliance Checker. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help,
index.what_happened_excerpt: Someone used a chatbot to help with regulatory compliance by connecting Google Drive and walking through understanding and applying regulatory requirements. They reviewed and analyzed documents, identified gaps and conflicting obligations,
